source.title: Cardiorenal outcomes of empagliflozin versus dapagliflozin in primary prevention among patients with type 2 diabetes: A nationwide cohort study

consistency_review: The source-defined primary-outcome equivalence margin (HR 0.86–1.16) was preserved as reported and not independently endorsed.
Secondary outcomes were reported as showing no statistically significant differences; the source did not establish separate equivalence margins for each secondary outcome.
Reference 2 is bibliographically incomplete in the supplied PDF and is preserved as printed in the reference task queue.
extraction_limitations: No supplementary file was present in the selected source packet.
The article is observational; appraisal judgments are not encoded as reported evidence atoms.
